hook: Nobody mentions this about your monitor's Ethernet port.
sentences: Your monitor's Ethernet port can be dropping packets without you knowing.
When the adapter can't keep up, it simply discards frames, cutting your speed.
Instead of asking "why is my speed slow?", try "enable Ethernet flow control on my router".
That tells the sender to pause and buffer, preventing drops.
Turning flow control on in the UniFi console lifted the download to about two gigabits.
Now you can keep the full line speed without extra hardware.
